description: Fetch the replies to one post, about 30 a page: each is a post, with its author, text, likes and replies, and `referenced_tweets` naming the post it answers. Give exactly one of `url` or `id`. Costs 13 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

name: get_x_replies
title: Get the replies to an X post
